caption:
An alien and a zombie brawl over the last glazed donut.
Seedance 2.5 delivered this hilarious diner fight scene.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 30 seconds, 16:9, cinematic comedy, 35mm lens, cool fluorescent diner light with warm display case glow, dynamic camera moves, snappy comedic pacing.

CHARACTERS:
THE ZOMBIE: Tall, gaunt, grey mottled skin, sunken pale eyes, ragged navy security guard shirt with askew clip-on tie.
THE ALIEN: Petite, smooth lilac skin, large black almond eyes, four-fingered hands, oversized yellow hooded poncho, small strap camera.
FROZEN PATRONS: Cashier and diners frozen mid-action in background.

LOCATION:
Retro 24-hour donut diner at 2 AM. Red vinyl booths, chrome counter stools, lit glass display case with ONE glazed donut on a doily.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:11.8) — Frozen Standoff. Medium shot pushing along the counter. Spilled coffee hangs frozen mid-air. THE ZOMBIE and THE ALIEN gaze at the last glazed donut inside the glass case, then glare at each other across the frozen liquid ribbon. Dialogue: ALIEN: "I have crossed four galaxies for this donut." ZOMBIE: "I died for this donut." ALIEN: "That is not the same thing." MUST SHOW: Suspended mid-air coffee stream, lone glazed donut on doily.

SHOT 2 (00:11.8-00:13.7) — Aisle Scramble. Wide tracking shot down diner floor. THE ZOMBIE lunges with a stiff swipe; THE ALIEN ducks, kicks a stool, and scrambles across the floor.

SHOT 3 (00:13.7-00:18.8) — Counter Brawl. Medium shot angled along counter stools. THE ALIEN vaults onto the counter and fires a bright camera flash directly into THE ZOMBIE’s face, causing him to stagger backward past frozen diners.

SHOT 4 (00:18.8-00:21.5) — Booth Vault. Wide tracking shot facing the red neon OPEN sign. THE ALIEN leaps mid-air across booth seat backs in the bright yellow poncho, evading THE ZOMBIE’s grasping hands.

SHOT 5 (00:21.5-00:30.1) — Truce and Grab. Medium shot framing the display case. Both pant over the frozen coffee ribbon. ALIEN: "Share?" ZOMBIE: "Share." They shake hands. At 00:27, time snaps back: the coffee splashes down, diners unfreeze, and both dive cheek-to-cheek, wrestling and grinning over the lone donut. MUST SHOW: Coffee splashing downward upon unfreezing, both characters cheek-to-cheek holding the one donut.

SOUND:
Muffled silence during freeze with raspy dialogue and fabric rustles. Instant loud coffee splash, diner ambiance, and customer gasps as time unfreezes. No background music.
prompt_short: A zombie and an alien freeze time inside a 2am diner to fight over the last glazed donut, vaulting over stools before calling a truce and grabbing the pastry together cheek-to-cheek.
